_readme: Authoring rules for scenes and poses that come from PHYSICAL damage history, enforced by
services/scenes/sceneValidator.js (npm run validate:scenes, and the /scenes/api/replace and
/poses/api/replace endpoints). This is NOT the retired runtime safety-limit system
(config/hardware-safety.json stays empty by operator ruling 2026-08-20): nothing here clamps or
refuses a command at play time. It only stops an authored scene or pose from being SAVED in a
shape that has hurt this hardware before, so the show never does it unattended.
Keys are character ids (data/characters.json), part ids are strings as in parts.json.
exclusiveParts:  part-id sets that must never move together - not in one pose, not in one
step, not in one concurrent group of steps.
partAngleRanges: allowed real-degree window for a servo; forbidPresets refuses usePreset
(__MIN__/__MAX__ on an uncalibrated multi-turn part can mean a full wrap),
forbidContinuous refuses a continuous spin target in a pose.
maxMotorSpeed:   ceiling for every motor part of the character, in percent (a motor step
with no speed runs at the executor default of 50, so it must state one).

3._note: Elbow (4) and forearm (5) share a rail that has blown its fuse under simultaneous load.

4._note: Part 1 is the 900-degree multi-turn neck; outside 372-406 it wraps and tears the head cabling.

1._note: The wiper motor browns out and resets the Pi when started hard; never above 40 percent.
